edits.target: ## Final sanity pass (do this before committing)
edits.content: Visible check: write each finalist's quantifier skeleton (e.g. 'for all eps, exists C, for all N>=2, exists b'), parameter range, domain and hypotheses beside the stem's, and note which finalists use each symbol or term the stem defines (a tie-break signal, not an absolute). A finalist that reorders quantifiers, narrows or extends the range, relaxes or negates a stem hypothesis, or contains a rider that contradicts a stem definition or makes another clause of the same option vacuous or contradictory is the corruption. Discard it before any strength ranking. Among the rest, take the one whose every extra clause you can derive.

edits.content: If your choice carries an extra clause that you cannot derive or that fails a test, switch to the plainer option. Do this only if the plainer option is not a verbatim prefix of two or more other options (then compare the extensions per the clause vote and take the one whose extras survive), and it is not demonstrably false or strictly implied by a fully proved alternative.
